item.title: Apply to attend with 25% off: SUPAWEEKLY
item.description: Supabase Select is a curated conference for builders. Get first-hand information about what's coming soon in Supabase. Learn from some of the industry's most prominent builders. Meet the Supabase team and get your questions answered. (2 sources: nodeweekly, postgresweekly)

item.title: Plan Advice in Postgres 19
item.description: There is a conversation that happens in every PostgreSQL shop eventually. A query that has been fine for a year gets slow overnight. Nothing was deployed. The … (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: The Unbearable Lightness of 'One More Index'
item.description: Thirty PostgreSQL schemas written by coding agents, loaded and measured. The indexes are competent; the cumulative cost is not. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Troubleshooting Row Lock Contention in Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL
item.description: Row lock contention can collapse database throughput during a flash sale even when CPU and I/O look healthy. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: Optimizing Aggregates: What Can an Extension Do?
item.description: Generated SQL is full of redundant sorts no one can edit out. PostgreSQL 19 lets an extension strip them at plan time: a 10M-row sum drops from 5.7s to 3.7s. By Andrei Lepikhov. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: pgrust 0.3: A Rust Rewrite of Postgres, Now Ready to Try
item.description: On a held-out corpus of 164,000 cases, divergences from Postgres fell from 1,454 in v0.2 to 11 in v0.3. (1 source: postgresweekly)
